full_prompt_en: A square sepia pencil illustration shows two expressive cartoon men facing one another on a broad expanse of yellowed paper. The background remains almost empty, with only faint specks, aging marks, and loose ground lines; this quiet surface gives the character silhouettes plenty of breathing room. On the left, a lanky man in a long dark coat leans forward from a low seat. His narrow torso, bent knees, long shoes, high forehead, and exaggerated rounded jaw are drawn with lively, uneven contours. A cigarette projects from his smiling mouth, and a light curl of smoke rises into the open paper above. Dark hatching builds the coat and trouser shadows, while his shirt and small bow tie remain much paler. On the right, a smaller man in a tall top hat sits low with his knees drawn up and his arms loosely folded over them. His long nose, thin grin, and wisps of dark hair answer the older figure's broad facial shapes. The hat is a compact dark mass above the lighter shirt and softly shaded trousers. A few sketchy decorative curls sit behind the left figure, and scattered pencil strokes under both characters suggest the floor without defining a room. The illumination is even and gentle, as if across a drawing sheet; there are no dramatic cast shadows, only graphite pressure and crosshatching to indicate volume. Lines alternate between thin exploratory traces and darker decisive strokes, with some smudged passages around fabric and shoes. The overall composition is playful and spacious, using a warm aged-paper field and economical dark pencil accents to stage a humorous exchange.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形棕褐色铅笔插画描绘两位表情生动的卡通男子，在大片泛黄纸面上相对而坐。背景几乎空白，只有淡淡斑点、旧化痕迹与松散的地面线条；安静的纸面让人物剪影有充分呼吸空间。左侧一位瘦长男子从矮座上向前倾身，穿深色长外套。他狭窄的躯干、弯起的膝盖、长鞋、高额头和夸张的圆下巴由活泼而略不齐整的轮廓描出。一支香烟从他微笑的嘴边伸出，浅淡烟缕向上飘入留白。密集排线建立外套和裤子的暗部，衬衫与小领结则浅得多。右侧一位较小的男子戴高礼帽，低低坐着，膝盖收起，双臂松松叠在上面。他的长鼻、细笑容和几缕深发回应左侧人物宽阔的面部形状。帽子在浅衬衫和柔和阴影的裤子上方成为紧凑深色块。左侧人物背后有几道草草画出的装饰卷线，两人脚下零散的铅笔痕迹暗示地面，却不界定具体房间。照明像均匀落在纸页上一样柔和，没有戏剧性投影，只有石墨压力变化和交叉排线表示体积。线条在纤细试探的草线与更深的确定笔划之间交替，衣料与鞋子附近有些晕擦痕。整体构图俏皮而疏朗，以暖旧纸面和节制的深色铅笔重点呈现幽默的交流。
style_prompt_en: A vintage pencil-and-ink animation-sketch treatment sits on warm, yellowed paper with visible flecks and gentle aging. Elastic contours vary from faint exploratory lines to confident dark strokes, giving simple forms a lively handmade movement. Narrow hatching and soft graphite smudges carry most of the shading; larger dark passages are concentrated in a few areas against expansive pale paper. Shapes are exaggerated and rounded, with long curves interrupted by sharp little accents, but the style does not depend on any particular subject. Depth stays shallow and lightly grounded by sparse marks rather than a fully drawn setting. Illumination is even, with volume supplied mainly by line density and rubbed tonal shifts instead of a strong external light source. The overall look is humorous, airy, and tactile, balancing spontaneous draftsmanship with readable silhouette design.
style_prompt_zh: 复古铅笔与墨线动画草稿落在温暖泛黄的纸面上，纸上可见斑点与轻微旧化。富弹性的轮廓从浅淡试探线变化为自信的深色笔划，让简单形体带着活泼的手工运动感。细排线和柔和石墨晕擦承担大部分阴影；少数区域聚集较大深色段落，与广阔浅纸面相对。形状夸张而圆润，长曲线间穿插小小尖锐重音，但画法并不依赖特定题材。纵深很浅，只用稀疏笔痕轻轻落地，而非描绘完整场景。照明均匀，体积主要由线条密度和擦出的明度变化提供，而非强外部光源。整体幽默、通透且可触，在自发起稿与易读的剪影设计之间保持平衡。
theme_en: Two expressive cartoon men in old-fashioned clothes sit facing one another
theme_zh: 两位穿旧式衣服、表情夸张的卡通男子相对而坐
name: 复古卡通钢笔素描
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
